risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively detailed and includes material quantitative information, but relies on broad forward-looking uncertainty statements regarding COVID-19, consumer demand, store closures, wholesale customers, and supply-chain disruption. Risk tone is substantially negative, supported by a 33% sales decline, significant net loss, $60 million of impairment charges, and operating losses in several segments, although management emphasizes brand resilience, e-commerce growth, and liquidity preservation.
